title: Add Optimization Config change permissions + operator roles (apply/promote/rollback)
author: Jordan Lee
description: Summary: Introduces explicit RBAC permissions for the Optimization Config lifecycle (create/validate/apply/promote/rollback) and adds two opinionated roles used by Console + control plane workflows. This is part of the Safe apply + rollback mechanism project to ensure rollback is both auditable and access-controlled. Motivation: Today, optimization config changes are implicitly covered by broad “platform operator” capabilities in some environments, and not consistently modeled in Private deployments. Enterprise customers and Security review require least-privilege roles with clear separation between “can propose” and “can execute rollback in prod.” Changes included: 1) New permissions: optimization_config.read, optimization_config.create_version, optimization_config.validate, optimization_config.diff, optimization_config.apply, optimization_config.promote, optimization_config.rollback, optimization_config.override_gates (break-glass), optimization_config.manage_rbac (internal only). 2) New roles: optimization_change_operator (intended for on-call + platform operators executing safe apply/rollback within an approved scope; includes read/diff/validate/apply/rollback; does NOT include promote-by-default to reduce accidental broad rollouts), optimization_change_admin (intended for senior operators; includes promote + override_gates; still does not include manage_rbac). 3) Updates to policy docs: clarified mapping from Console actions (“Rollback” button, “Promote to production”, “Override gates”) to permissions and recommended reviewer/approval process. 4) Tests: added rego/policy tests + golden snapshots covering allow/deny cases for Hosted/Dedicated/Private personas, including a regression test for INT-3390 (operator could not see rollback button due to missing permission). Backwards compatibility: No default widening of access; existing roles are unchanged except for documentation noting recommended migration. Control plane/Console will explicitly request these permissions when the feature flag is enabled. Rollout plan: Land policy bundle first; then enable in staging; then gate Console button visibility on optimization_config.rollback + server-side authz checks in control plane. Notes: “override_gates” is explicitly separate and intended for internal break-glass flows only (guarded by additional approval and audited separately).
commits: Update role mapping docs for safe apply/rollback Console flows
Add policy tests + golden snapshots for apply/promote/rollback
Tighten break-glass override permission + add deny-by-default coverage

conversation: Marcus Lin (review): Can we make sure rollback is not implicitly granted via promote? I’d prefer rollback to be in operator and promote to be in admin only. Also, “override_gates” should be separate and deny-by-default. Jordan Lee (author): Agreed. Updated role split: operator includes rollback but not promote; admin includes promote + override_gates. Added explicit denies + tests. Naomi Feldman (review): Please add a note in docs that Console must check BOTH the permission and server-side authz. We don’t want clients inferring from UI state. Also confirm audit events will include actor role/permission context (even if emitted elsewhere). Jordan Lee: Added doc section “UI visibility vs enforcement” and a pointer to audit requirements; audit payload fields are enforced in control plane, but we reference required fields and recommend including evaluated permissions in debug logs only (not audit events). Ethan Park (review): For Private deployments, do we have a clear mapping for customer-admin vs operator? Jordan Lee: Added guidance in docs/optimization-config-rbac.md: recommend customer define a limited operator group with optimization_change_operator and restrict by tenant/model/region scopes. Chloe Martin (review): Any impact on existing Console pages that list config history? Jordan Lee: Added optimization_config.read/diff to operator and admin; existing read-only views should map to read/diff. Benji Okafor (review): Please include a regression test for the exact permission check the rollback endpoint will use (optimization_config.rollback). Jordan Lee: Added test case “rollback_requires_permission” and updated golden snapshot. Marcus Lin (final): Looks good after the split + deny-by-default. Approving. Naomi Feldman (final): Approved with doc updates. Ethan Park (final): Approved. Chloe Martin (final): Approved.
release_notes: RBAC: Added optimization config lifecycle permissions and new roles for safe apply/rollback. Console/control plane can now gate rollback/promote actions via explicit permissions.
